description: Bundled neon tube bank: five curl-perturbed sinusoidal glass tubes with banded gas columns, comet-tailed light packets and flickering arcs where tubes cross. Bass, mids and treble each weight the tubes' thickness and packet speed; the pointer bends the bundle, clicks flare it, and the afterglow persists.
name: Neon Pulse Stream

params.name: Flow Speed
params.description: Drift rate of the tube centrelines and their packets.

params.name: Tube Density
params.description: Packet spacing along each tube (maps to zoom_params.y).

params.name: Glow Threshold
params.description: Luminance key threshold for the neon alpha (zoom_params.z).

params.name: Key Softness
params.description: Softness of the luminance key edge (zoom_params.w).
